takeaway.text: Valve releases complete Steam Controller CAD files under Creative Commons, scoring 1,250 HN points — the largest open hardware release by a consumer gaming company in the industry's history. The practitioner class is simultaneously mapping which modifications become immediately practical and interrogating the strategic calculus of open hardware release timing.
